CoinWallet is a decentralized, non-custodial wallet independently developed by CoinsDo, utilizing a Trusted Shards Computation (TSC) algorithm for joint asset management.

TSC offers a new approach to enhance the security of private key management in cryptocurrency wallets. By leveraging a Trusted Execution Environment (TEE), TSC divides the private key into multiple key shards, each stored on a different device. This strategy ensures the security of the private key; even if one device is compromised, the attacker cannot obtain the full private key information. Additionally, CoinsDo's TSC solution enables users to establish their own TEE environment on AWS, further optimizing security.

TSC is adaptable to various use cases. For example, it can act as a safe to assist digital asset custodians in sharding the private key and jointly holding a portion of the private key with customers, thereby enhancing customer asset management. It can also meet the needs of exchanges, digital finance, digital payments, family offices, and other businesses that require co-management of an asset pool. 

CoinWallet is practical, secure, and user-friendly, aiming to provide professionals with the most effective digital asset management solution, achieving the capabilities of a Multi-Party Computation  (MPC) wallet but at a much lower cost, and can be swiftly set up without maintenance.
